title: Director-General or Officer Disposal of Article

content.scenario: The Director-General or such other officer in India disposes of an article that is subject to speedy or natural decay, in a manner prescribed by regulations.
content.outcome: The Director-General or such other officer disposes of the article in the prescribed manner, allowing for the article's disposal without causing harm or loss.
